svg.aria-label: The talk's team as a house: the talk and the story at the top, the workshop and the studio, the evidence room, the office and an empty guard room, dev in the foundations, and every member's records as the ground
svg.text: the talk's repository, as a house
own folders only: placed by their work
the build, the workflows, the engine
the ground: every member writes its own records, team/<name>/, in one repository
